environment.database_identity: ephemeral non-root migration and runtime users

correctness_assertions: one unique listing work per occurrence
detail work count equals sources multiplied by details_per_source
all work business keys are unique
all due times stay inside the eight-hour daily window
all eight hourly buckets are populated and no bucket exceeds twice the mean
capacity projection is exact only when each runnable state stays within its 5000-row scan bound
capacity projection explicitly reports truncation otherwise
notes: The first L2 attempt stopped because the host filesystem was full while MySQL used an anonymous disk volume; it did not reach a product assertion.
The harness now places ephemeral MySQL capacity data on an explicitly bounded tmpfs, preventing interrupted tests from leaking large anonymous database volumes.
L3, L4, 24-hour spread, five-times peak, executor latency, artifact volume, and backup/restore remain release-gate work.
